metadata.name: Bolt / Nut Strength Class Typed Library
metadata.description: Faz 2.8.3 typed, additive bolt strength class (ISO 898-1 + ISO 3506-1 stainless) and nut property class (ISO 898-2) reference data. Distinct from and does not replace the generic strength_class_library.json (Phase 1.3/2.4.1 StrengthClassRecord shell).

bolt_records.notes_tr: Rp0.2=240 MPa, Rm=400 MPa ve sertlik aralığı mevcut strength_class_library.json'daki doğrulanmış (validated) SC-BOLT-4.6 kaydından alınmıştır. proof_stress_mpa bu fazda Rp0.2 ile aynı kabul edilmiştir (basitleştirme -- standardın ayrı proof-load gerilmesi tablosu bu fazda bağımsız olarak doğrulanmadı). diameter_min/max_mm genel ISO 898-1 uygulama aralığı olarak M5-M39 kullanılmıştır; sınıfa özgü daha dar aralıklar (ör. 9.8 icin M1.6-M16) bu fazda ayrıca doğrulanmadı.
bolt_records.notes_en: Rp0.2=240 MPa, Rm=400 MPa and the hardness range are reused from the already-validated SC-BOLT-4.6 record in strength_class_library.json. proof_stress_mpa is set equal to Rp0.2 this phase (simplification -- the standard's separate proof-load stress table was not independently re-verified). diameter_min/max_mm uses the general ISO 898-1 applicability range M5-M39; narrower class-specific ranges (e.g. 9.8 limited to M1.6-M16) were not separately verified this phase.
bolt_records.source: ISO 898-1; Rp0.2/Rm/hardness reused from validated SC-BOLT-4.6 (strength_class_library.json); elongation/diameter-range/heat-treatment/proof-stress added Faz 2.8.3 as reference-level engineering data

bolt_records.heat_treatment: Cold worked (strain hardened); no heat treatment (austenitic stainless)
bolt_records.notes_tr: ISO 3506-1 östenitik paslanmaz civata property class'ı. 8.8/10.9/12.9 (ISO 898-1 karbon/alaşımlı çelik) ile DOĞRUDAN eşdeğer SAYILMAMALIDIR -- farklı malzeme ailesi ve farklı standart. Rp0.2/Rm değerleri genel mühendislik referansı düzeyindedir (provisional); bu fazda ISO 3506-1 birincil tablosuna karşı bağımsız doğrulama yapılmadı. Sertlik alanı bu fazda tahmin edilmeyip boş bırakıldı.
bolt_records.notes_en: ISO 3506-1 austenitic stainless bolt property class. Must NOT be treated as directly equivalent to 8.8/10.9/12.9 (ISO 898-1 carbon/alloy steel) -- different material family and different standard. Rp0.2/Rm values are general engineering-reference level (provisional); not independently verified against the primary ISO 3506-1 table this phase. Hardness fields intentionally left unset rather than guessed.
bolt_records.source: ISO 3506-1 (general engineering reference, not independently re-verified against primary standard text this phase)
bolt_records.engineering_warning: ISO 3506-1 full calculation scope (size-dependent proof load, coefficient-of-friction interaction, corrosion class) is not implemented this phase. Values are indicative only; verify against the primary ISO 3506-1 table before production use.
